title: ALLaM: Large Language Models for Arabic and English
findings: The paper's key finding related to religion is methodological: it demonstrates the inclusion of religious topics as part of a broader dataset covering culture and various knowledge domains (e.g., 'middle eastern culture, religions') to train and align a large language model for the Arabic context. No specific performance metrics or analyses related to religion were reported.

measurement_description: The paper did not use a specific benchmark to measure performance on faith/religion. Instead, 'religion' was included as a data domain for Supervised Fine-Tuning and 'religions' and 'middle eastern culture' were used as sources for preference data prompts. This was done to ensure the model's general proficiency and cultural alignment, particularly for the Arabic language.
